experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r22, 8; st.w $r22, $r20, 0; li.d $r22, -8; st.w $r22, $r20, 8; li.d $r21, 0' --asm 'ldgt.w $r4, $r20, $r21; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'
experiments.notes: rj -> rd chain, the bound stays 0 so the check passes; add.d subtracted.

latencies.notes: rj -> rd chain, the bound stays 0 so the check passes; add.d subtracted.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r22, 0; st.d $r22, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0' --asm 'ldgt.w $r4, $r20, $r4; xori $r4, $r4, 1'
experiments.notes: rk -> rd chain: the bound toggles 0/1 through xori and always stays below the address; xori subtracted.

latencies.notes: rk -> rd chain: the bound toggles 0/1 through xori and always stays below the address; xori subtracted.

throughput.name: 8 independent addresses
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r21, $r20, 0; addi.d $r23, $r20, 8; addi.d $r24, $r20, 16; addi.d $r25, $r20, 24; addi.d $r26, $r20, 32; addi.d $r27, $r20, 40; addi.d $r28, $r20, 48; addi.d $r29, $r20, 56; addi.d $r30, $r20, -8; addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'ldgt.w $r12, $r21, $r30; ldgt.w $r13, $r23, $r30; ldgt.w $r14, $r24, $r30; ldgt.w $r15, $r25, $r30; ldgt.w $r16, $r26, $r30; ldgt.w $r17, $r27, $r30; ldgt.w $r18, $r28, $r30; ldgt.w $r19, $r29, $r30'

notes: L1D-hit bound-checked load; the address path and the bound path are recorded separately.
